Package app.swea2

Class BudgetAlert

java.lang.Object
app.swea2.BudgetAlert
class BudgetAlert extends Object
An alert event generated when a Budget crosses a threshold. Alerts are stored on the Budget and may also be surfaced as Notification objects on the owning User.
